verification_report.summary: The proof is correct under the stated conventions and accepted earlier book results. Rational atomic probabilities admit normalized Green potentials converging to zero in L1. Scaling by a=1-tau stays theta-psh in the same background, and ideal projection preserves normalization, idempotence, and the analytic logarithmic type. Ordinary equivalence up to a locally bounded remainder preserves the exact pole/Lelong coefficients; local boundedness off the finite pole set prevents any additional polar mass loss. Thus MA_theta(r_j)=theta+dd^c r_j-a nu_j has mass tau and converges weakly to tau theta, while the ideal metric distance to zero tends to zero. The proof makes none of the excluded capacity, d_S, incompleteness, novelty, or Popovici claims.
